footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $92.6M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.2% to $4.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 5.9%, versus 5.5% a year earlier, and operating income rose 13.4× to $109M, a 2.6% margin.
The net loss narrowed to $33.8M, or −$0.39 per share, from $222M. Operating cash flow was $109M and free cash flow $56.6M, versus −$123M.
watch: Net income includes a $92.6M tax benefit.
sources: Calumet, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: Our business depends on supply and demand fundamentals, which can be adversely affected by numerous macroeconomic factors outside of our control
Our business has exposure to some commodities which are volatile…
Our hedging activities may not be effective in reducing our exposure to commodity price risk and may reduce our earnings, profitability and cash flows
Decreases in the price of inventory and products may lead to a reduction in the borrowing base under our revolving credit facility…
We depend on certain key suppliers and third-party pipelines for transportation of feedstocks and products, and if these suppliers…
The price volatility of utility services may result in decreases in our earnings, profitability and cash flows
